description.zh: 目录在文件系统中的绝对路径。
description.en: The absolute path of the directory in the file system.

description.zh:
要取消的Uid或Gid。

当UserType=Uid或Gid时必填且有意义。

例如：

- 要取消Uid=500的用户，则UserType填Uid，UserId填500。
- 要取消Gid=100的用户组，则UserType填Gid，UserId填100。
description.en:
The UID or GID to cancel.

This parameter is required and valid only when UserType is set to Uid or Gid.

Examples:

- To cancel the quota for the user whose UID is 500, set UserType to Uid and UserId to 500.
- To cancel the quota for the user group whose GID is 100, set UserType to Gid and UserId to 100.

description.zh:
用户类型。

取值：

- Uid：用户ID
- Gid：用户所属组ID
- AllUsers：所有用户
description.en:
The user type.

Valid values:

- Uid: user ID
- Gid: user group ID
- AllUsers: all users.

title.zh: 取消文件系统的目录配额
title.en: Cancel a directory quota for a file system

descriptions.zh: 仅通用型NAS NFS文件系统支持目录配额功能。
descriptions.en: Only General-purpose NAS NFS file systems support the directory quota feature.
